findings.value: A council-run community hub just off Bethnal Green Road, with halls and rooms for hire by community groups, social clubs, youth groups and residents.

evidence.quote: Set just off Bethnal Green Road, Granby Community Hub is perfect for a range of activities

notes: Council hire page read in full; it is the only source. One WebSearch found no website of its own and no press. Not a music or nights venue on any source read. The council's event listing gives the address as 37 St Matthew's Row with a cut postcode, so the facts researcher needs the full postcode.
